question: Which address received the most PLTR (Palantir Technologies • Robinhood Token, token 0x894e1ec2d74ffe5aef8dc8a9e84686accb964f2a) on Robinhood Chain in the last 6 hours? Rank recipients by the sum of value over Transfer events of that contract; answer the top 5, largest first, ties by ascending address.

recipe.event: event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)

definitions.logs: Canonical non-removed Transfer(address,address,uint256) logs emitted by the specified token, each counted once by block number and log index.
definitions.figure: The leading recipient total in raw token units.
definitions.window: Both block endpoints are inclusive; the pinned block range defines the six-hour window without an additional timestamp filter.
definitions.ranking: Select five recipients with the largest sums, descending; equal sums are ordered by lowercase address ascending.
definitions.received: Gross sum of Transfer value grouped by indexed to address; outgoing transfers are not subtracted. Include all recipients, including contracts and the zero address, and all mint, burn, self-transfer and zero-value events.
definitions.denomination: Raw unsigned uint256 value units of PLTR contract 0x894e1ec2d74ffe5aef8dc8a9e84686accb964f2a; no decimal conversion.
